fields.headline: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center Restoring Electronic Systems After IT Incident
fields.subhead: Patient safety was never affected and no patient information was accessed, the hospital says
fields.body:
Ottawa River Regional Medical Center is restoring its electronic systems after a cyber incident that began early Tuesday morning.

Patient safety was never affected and no patient information was accessed. Care has continued without interruption using paper records, and the Emergency Department remains open for emergencies.

We expect to be fully back to normal by tomorrow morning. We thank our patients and our staff for their patience.

Families with questions may call the hospital information line at 555-0130 or visit the updates page on the hospital website.
fields.boilerplate: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center is a 412-bed, not-for-profit hospital and Level II trauma center in Toledo, Ohio, serving Lucas County and the surrounding region.

snapshot.title: Press Release — EHR Downtime and Public Statement

fields.headline: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center Addressing Cyber Incident; EHR Downtime Underway
fields.subhead: Hospital confirms unauthorized access to electronic health records; systems being restored from secure backup
fields.body:
Ottawa River Regional Medical Center is restoring its electronic health record (EHR) systems following a confirmed cyber incident that began at 05:31 this morning. The hospital is currently operating under paper-based documentation procedures across all units, as mandated by the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026).

The incident involved unauthorized access to the EHR database servers, ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02, which resulted in encryption of the database and deletion of on-site backups. Forensic analysis confirms that protected health information was exfiltrated prior to encryption. The hospital has engaged external forensic experts and is working with the FBI and CISA to investigate the incident.

The immutable cloud backup from 02:00 a.m. has been verified and will be used to restore the EHR. Clinical systems are expected to resume in a controlled environment by 04:00 Wednesday, March 4, 2026. The Administrator on Call has authorized return to normal operations only after verification of data integrity, medication safety, and system functionality.

No patient was harmed as a result of the incident. All care continues to be provided safely using paper-based documentation and manual verification processes. The hospital is not currently accepting ambulances and has activated diversion protocols in coordination with the Lucas County Emergency Management Agency.

Families seeking information about patients may contact the Family Reunification Center at (555) 0112 or visit the hospital’s website at www.orrmc.example/updates. Media inquiries should be directed to the Public Information Office at (555) 0130 or media@orrmc.example.
fields.boilerplate: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center is a 412-bed, non-profit, tertiary care hospital serving Lucas County and surrounding regions in northwest Ohio. As a designated Level II trauma center and accredited by the American College of Surgeons, the hospital provides advanced care across 12 inpatient units, 12 operating rooms, and 12 outpatient centers. The hospital is a member of the Ohio Health Information Exchange and a partner in regional emergency preparedness under the ORRMC Emergency Operations Plan (ORRMC-EOP-2026).
